environment: Local deterministic fixture replay in Chrome; no sportsbook requests or production writes
scope: Presentation behavior and responsive layout, not live sportsbook timing
viewports: Chrome responsive preview: 375 by 800 CSS pixels
checks: FanDuel CAR moneyline +160 to +175 records an upward payout move with the previous price
FanDuel CAR moneyline +175 to +145 records a downward payout move
A +3.5 to +4 spread change is labeled as a line change and kept separate from the other book's +3.5 line
A suspended FanDuel quote is labeled Paused and cannot win Best Price
Reopening is an availability change, not a payout arrow
Simulated FanDuel failure labels the source stale and excludes its prices from Best Price
Recovery and an interrupted SSE connection return to connected status without inventing additional price moves
Price history shows the observed changes and gaps, with the tab-local history limitation visible
The DraftKings view and decimal odds load correctly from ?view=draftkings&odds=decimal
The FanDuel view and American odds load correctly from ?view=fanduel&odds=american
Search filters the board and a fresh unfiltered page shows all 29 games
Final accessible quote description includes Higher payout, previously +145 after +145 to +175
At 375px width, source cards, filters, recent moves, quote cards and the history chart fit the viewport
limits: Fixture changes establish deterministic UI behavior, not actual live-game performance or provider latency
Responsive preview is not a physical mobile-device test
This manual record supplements automated presentation, source-state and integration tests
